events.name: Bash
events.head: Check git sync state and publish hold
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git status -sb | head -1; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; git rev-list --count main..origin/main; git branch --contains a8e393a | head; git remote -v | head -2; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect unpushed commits, T-278 commits, coord log
events.input: $ git log --oneline origin/main..main; git log --oneline -8 --all --grep="T-278"; tail -15 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-260; grep -rn "cal/p/" cloud/src/calendar.ts | head; grep -n "^name\|routes\|pattern" cloud/wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate cloud config and hosted Worker URL
events.input: $ ls cloud/ | head -30; grep -rn "workers.dev\|centre.*https" app/src/lib/*.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -o "https://[a-zA-Z0-9.\-]*" | sort | uniq -c | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe hosted Worker for the JSON feed route
events.input: $ for p in /cal/p/0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.json /cal/p/0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.ics /api/health; do printf "%s " $p; curl -s -o /tmp/o.txt -w "%{http_code} " "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev$p"; head -c 150 /tmp/o.txt; echo; done; sed -n 80,140p cloud/src/calendar.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find feed token usages and ?f= handling
events.input: $ grep -rln "feed_token\|feedToken\|/cal/p/" cloud/src app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | head -30; echo ---; grep -rn "?f=\|\"f\")\|get(\"f\")" app/src cloud/src | head

events.text: Checking where the confirmation and reminder emails and invite description are built so the ?f= join link can be added.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List feed token and join link sites in Worker
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src && grep -n "feed_token\|/cal/p/\|joinPage\|workshop/join\|masterclass/success/join" reminders.ts followups.ts lane.ts payments.ts nurture.ts calendar.ts index.ts | cut -c1-220 | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read reminder header and template copy markers
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p reminders.ts | cut -c1-240; grep -n "COPY\b\|const COPY\|key: \"\|{{" reminders.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -40; grep -rn "SITE_ORIGIN\|site_url\|SITE_URL\|tantra-workshop-live\|adisuja.github.io" . | cut -c1-200 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey reminder copy templates and site origin
events.input: $ wc -l reminder-copy.ts; grep -n "custom\.\|key\|name:" reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-230 | head -50; grep -rn "github.io" ../../app/next.config.* ../../app/src/lib/*.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -5

events.text: Adding a `join_page_url` field (the join page with `?f=<token>`) to the reminder emails. Next I'm finding the public site origin and the invite description.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find site base path, mirror URL, ICS description
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -n "basePath\|assetPrefix" app/next.config.* | head -5; grep -rn "tantra-workshop-live" app/scripts/*.sh app/scripts/*.mjs cloud/src 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-180 | head -5; grep -n "description\|DESCRIPTION\|join line\|private link" app/src/lib/calendar.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -20; grep -n "PUBLIC_URL\|SITE" cloud/wrangler.jsonc cloud/src/util.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read calendar description builder
events.input: $ sed -n 50,135p app/src/lib/calendar.ts; grep -n "personalFeedPath\|SITE_URL\|export const" app/src/lib/calendar.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check where the join pages are hosted
events.input: $ for u in https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/workshop/join/ https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/masterclass/success/join/ https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/workshop/join/ https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/success/join/; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url} $u\n" "$u"; done; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -n "ownSeat\|CENTRE\|origin" app/src/lib/centre-url.ts | head
